name: IVC Road, Devanahalli
tagline: Space to build, along a changing northern corridor.
description: IVC Road is a plotted-development corridor in the wider Devanahalli–Yelahanka setting. The surrounding area includes village settlements, larger land parcels and institutions such as Stonehill International School at Tarahunise. A plot here needs to be understood through its phase, dimensions and development services, not just its distance from the airport.
